body.p: This listing of claims replaces all prior versions of the claims.

br.br:
1. (Currently Amended) A method, comprising:detecting by a processing node that a transport has parked at a first location of an event;
determine by the processing node a pickup location where the transport is to be located at a pickup time, wherein the pickup location and the pickup time are based on a time of a conclusion of the event obtained from a device of an occupant of the transport; and
in response to the processing node receiving a modified pickup time for the conclusion of the event from the device, causing [[by]] the processing node the transport to move to a second location intermediate between the first location and the pickup location at the modified pickup time, wherein the second location is closer to the pickup location than the first location.
2. (Previously Presented) The method of claim 1, further comprising:causing the transport to move to the pickup location when the device approaches the pickup location.
3. (Previously Presented) The method of claim 1, wherein the detecting that the transport has parked at the first location further comprises:detecting that the transport has parked at the first location based on video data received from at least one camera.
4. (Previously Presented) The method of claim 1, wherein the detecting that the transport has parked at the first location further comprises:
detecting that the transport has parked at the first location based on a change in an operation status of the transport.
5. (Previously Presented) The method of claim 1, wherein the detecting that the transport has parked at the first location further comprises:detecting that the transport has parked at the first location based on a sensor of the transport indicating that the occupant of the transport has exited the transport.
6. (Previously Presented) The method of claim 1, comprising:receiving an agreement to move the transport from the device.
7. (Previously Presented) The method of claim 1, comprising:determining the second location based on one or more vehicles vacating a parking spot between the first location and the pickup location.
8. (Currently Amended) A system, comprising:a processor that, when executing instructions stored in a memory, is configured to:
determine a pickup location where the transport is to be located at a pickup time, wherein the pickup location and the pickup time are based on a time of a conclusion of the event obtained from a device of an occupant of the transport; and
in response to a modified pickup time for the conclusion of the event being received from the device, cause the transport to move to a second location intermediate between the first location and the pickup location at the modified pickup time, wherein the second location is closer to the pickup location than the first location.
9. (Previously Presented) The system of claim 8, wherein the processor is further configured to:cause the transport to move to the pickup location when the device approaches the pickup location.
10. (Previously Presented) The system of claim 8, wherein when the processor detects that the transport has parked at the first location, the processor is further configured to:detect that the transport has parked at the first location based on video data from at least one camera.
11. (Previously Presented) The system of claim 8, wherein when the processor detects that the transport has parked at the first location, the processor is further configured to:detect that the transport has parked at the first location based on a change in an operation status of the transport.
12. (Previously Presented) The system of claim 8, wherein when the processor detects that the transport has parked at the first location, the processor is further configured to:detect that the transport has parked at the first location based on a sensor of the transport indicating that the occupant of the transport has exited the transport.
13. (Previously Presented) The system of claim 8, wherein the processor is further configured to:receive an agreement to move the transport from the device associated with the transport.
14. (Previously Presented) The system of claim 8, wherein the processor is further configured to:determine the second location based on one or more vehicles vacating a parking spot between the first location and the pickup location.
15. (Currently Amended) A non-transitory computer-readable medium comprising instructions that, when executed by a processor, cause the processor to perform:detecting that a transport has parked at a first location of an event;
determine a pickup location where the transport is to be located at a pickup time, wherein the pickup location and the pickup time are based on a time of a conclusion of the event obtained from a device of an occupant of the transport; and
in response to receiving a modified pickup time for the conclusion of the event from the device, causing the transport to move to a second location intermediate between the first location and the pickup location at the modified pickup time, wherein the second location is closer to the pickup location than the first location.
16. (Previously Presented) The non-transitory computer-readable medium of claim 15, wherein the instructions further cause the processor to perform comprising:causing the transport to move to the pickup location when the device approaches the pickup location.
17. (Previously Presented) The non-transitory computer-readable medium of claim 15, wherein the detecting that the transport has parked at the first location further comprises:
detecting that the transport has parked at the first location based on video data received from at least one camera.
18. (Previously Presented) The non-transitory computer-readable medium of claim 15, wherein the detecting that the transport has parked at the first location further comprises:detecting that the transport has parked at the first location based on a change in an operation status of the transport.
19. (Previously Presented) The non-transitory computer-readable medium of claim 15, wherein the detecting that the transport has parked at the first location further comprises:detecting that the transport has parked at the first location based on a sensor of the transport indicating that the occupant of the transport has exited the transport.
20. (Previously Presented) The non-transitory computer-readable medium of claim 15, wherein the detecting that the transport has parked at the first location further comprises:determining the second location based on one or more vehicles vacating a parking spot between the first location and the pickup location.
